messages.subject: Time recording — April narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Our records show 14.5 hours recorded in April with missing or incomplete narratives. Please complete your narratives by Friday so we can run the month-end bills. The biggest gap is on matter 00149 (Pennington/Project Sentinel).

Regards,
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
